instruction: BUILD+DEPLOY BlackWatch-instrumented client and VALIDATE the logger (cycle 151, OAAW, short run). Verify markers (BlackWatch, blackWatchProc, F0 boost FAITHFUL, *noDrawMax writes=2) NOT size. Config BOTH default.json: AutoLogin=true, AutoWalk=false, FastAutoWalk=false, AutoBattle=true, SpeedBoost=14; readback. Delete stale blackwatch.log. Build via human-b1diag-go.ps1 (if build fails, report error C lines + NEEDS_INPUT). Launch, Start once, auto-login, ~45s idle in-world (NO walk). Find blackwatch.log (C:\zmffk AND D:\SA\zmffk), copy to out+bus. Validate: exists+non-empty, HB line count, GAP-START count, first+last HB verbatim, frame= increased first->last (sampler works), boost14 HB shows ndmax=14 & sys=1. PASS if frame advanced. Teardown but LEAVE deployed exe/dll for owner's manual test. No commit. See INSTRUCTION.md.
notes: Owner's plan: instrument client+launcher logs comprehensively, owner manually reproduces the boost-14 black (free walk / after-encounter), notes the wall-clock time, analyst matches log. This cycle only builds+validates the logger; owner does the real repro next on the deployed build.
